title: SiteDetail - Tooling API
description: Represents the details of a Salesforce site or Experience Cloud site. Available in API version 38.0 and later.

DurableId.description: The ID of the Site object.

IsRegistrationEnabled.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsRegistrationEnabled.description: Indicates whether the site allows users to sign up.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<xsd:complexType name="SiteDetail">
  <xsd:complexContent>
    <xsd:extension base="ens:sObject">
      <xsd:sequence>
        <xsd:element name="DurableId" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="IsRegistrationEnabled" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="SecureUrl" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string" nillable="true"/>
      </xsd:sequence>
    </xsd:extension>
  </xsd:complexContent>
</xsd:complexType>
```
